claims.evidence: Photos only show exterior surfaces at a distance; no close-up of wood grain, joints, or mechanism wear.
Only 'MERCURY' branding visible on body; no country-of-origin marking or serial plate shown.
This is a treadle table with cast-iron leg mechanism and foot pedal plate; no electric motor is visible in any photo, so a running motor cannot exist as described.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual
claims.evidence: No photo shows bobbins, needles, spare parts, or a manual.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong
claims.evidence: Service history cannot be seen in any photo; this is a claim about the past with no visual trace.

risks.proof: Video clip of the treadle being pumped and the wheel/needle moving

risks.risk: Wood frame/table may have cracks, woodworm, or structural weakness
risks.proof: Close-up photos of leg joints, underside, and drawer wood

risks.risk: Internal mechanical parts (gears, shuttle, tension assembly) may be rusted or worn
risks.proof: Photo of open machine head interior and shuttle area

risks.risk: Accessories (bobbins, needles, manual) claimed but not shown may be missing

risks.risk: Stitch quality/tension may be inconsistent despite cosmetic appearance

risks.risk: Country of origin (Japanese-made claim) cannot be confirmed, affecting collector value
risks.proof: Clear photo of serial plate or maker's mark stating origin

proof_requests: Video of the treadle being operated showing wheel and needle movement
Close-up of wood joints, legs, and underside of table for cracks or woodworm
Photo of machine head interior (shuttle, gears, tension assembly)
Photo of all claimed accessories and the manual laid out together
Short video of an actual test stitch on fabric
Clear photo of any serial number or origin marking on the machine
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a Mercury treadle sewing machine table, so it can be priced, but every seller claim beyond the bare identity is unverified or contradicted (no motor exists on a treadle unit), so it must be priced at worst case pending proof.
